comparison.score_precision_note: Legacy scores are rounded to 0.01; promotion also requires a positive lower bound after allowing 0.01 for median-difference rounding.
comparison.caveat: Paired bootstrap uses clean arrival pairs only and excludes systematic simulator-model error. Incomplete runs are reported separately; a harness timeout is not an official competition disqualification.
